## Outcome

Describe the observable behavior delivered by this change.

## Scope and boundaries

- Environment(s):
- Data classification: synthetic only
- Trust boundary changed: yes / no
- Billable resources changed: yes / no

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests pass
- [ ] Integration or runtime check passes where applicable
- [ ] Secrets and internal metadata scan passes
- [ ] Documentation and contracts are updated
- [ ] Cost and teardown impact is documented
- [ ] Browser-rendered behavior is verified for UI changes

## Evidence

List commands and sanitized post-action observations. Use Confirmed, Partial, Unavailable, Unverified, or Failed.

## Rollback

State the exact safe rollback or explain why the change has no runtime effect.
